The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job. Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them. Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs. Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses. Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path. Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended. Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client. Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need. Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.&nbsp;</span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position</strong></h2> <p>Vinted is Europe's largest online C2C marketplace for second-hand fashion. jobs.description: Unser „Nägele Engineering“-Team will weiter wachsen, neue Themenfelder erschließen und in den bisherigen seine Kompetenzen vervollständigen. Haben Sie Lust, für einige Monate bei uns hineinzuschnuppern, im Bereich optischer und mechanischer Verfahrenstechnik oder Umwelttechnik spannende Entwicklungsprojekte zu bearbeiten, gegebenenfalls im Rahmen einer Bachelor- oder Masterarbeit? jobs.title: Werkstudent Bewerbermanagement (mind. 15h/Woche)
jobs.description: Wir haben ambitionierte Ziele. Werde ein Teil davon. Von 0 auf 40 Teammitglieder in fünf Jahren. Wir gehören als Mix aus Strategieberatung und Kreativagentur zu den am schnellsten wachsenden inhabergeführten Beratungsunternehmen Süddeutschlands und möchten unseren Weg auch in Zukunft erfolgreich fortsetzen. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du in unseren Seminaren und im Podcast selbst auftreten. Mitgestalten: Du entscheidest mit, welche Marken wir aufnehmen und wie der Bereich arbeitet. Du führst Daten aus Seller Central, AMALYTIX, Perpetua und anderen Tools zusammen und wertest sie damit aus. jobs.title: People Associate - Working Student
jobs.description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the team Are you curious about the operational side of HR and ready to start your career in a global tech company? Join our Germany country team as a People Associate Working Student. You'll get hands-on HR experience, work with friendly and ambitious colleagues, and see your work make a difference every day. Based in Berlin, reporting into Team Lead, HR Operations Germany. What you'll be doing Keep employee documents in order, including personal files (hard copy and electronic). Take care of post-related tasks. Team up with our Office Management team on overlapping topics. Support HR Ops and our People Partner in preparing presentations for different events. Help us set up and improve HR processes and tools. Organize team activities that bring people together. …and most importantly, be yourself and contribute to our team culture. Our humble expectations Growth-minded: You're willing to learn something new every day. Comms ace: You communicate well, with advanced German and fluent English. Problem solver: You bring a can-do attitude and tackle challenges head-on. Networker: You enjoy connecting with people across teams. Team player: You work well with others. Digitally fluent: You're comfortable with PowerPoint, Excel and Google Workspace. Bonus points: Experience with Workday, Jira and Slack, or with AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. Why you'll love working with us Real responsibility and ownership from day one. Lots of learning and growth in a high-growth, globally scaling tech company. An ambitious, friendly and humble team. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. jobs.title: Head of DACH
jobs.description: We’re looking for a sales leader who wants to build, lead and win in a fast growing startup that’s changing how legal research is done. You’ll take ownership of our DACH sales team, help us move upmarket and play a key role in shaping the next stage of Pandektes’ growth. About Pandektes Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear. We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale. Pandektes has raised more than € 17.5 million and most recently closed a € 13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland. About the role As our Head of DACH Sales, you’ll lead our sales team across Germany, Austria and Switzerland and take ownership of growing one of our key markets. You’ll manage and develop a team of Account Executives working across a wide range of customers and deal sizes. A big part of the role will be helping the team move further upmarket and win larger, more complex customers. You’ll stay close to the team and the deals, coaching regularly, joining important customer conversations and helping your AEs progress and close opportunities. This is a role for building, not maintaining. We recently closed our €13.5M Series A, and you’ll have the backing to hire, grow the team and take it upmarket. With 500+ customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland, customers already pay for the product, the team is in place, and there’s a lot of room to go bigger. Our processes and playbooks are still being built, so you’ll have a real say in how we sell. How you run pipeline, coaching and hiring will become how sales works at Pandektes as we scale. What you’ll do Lead and develop our DACH Account Executive team Coach the team through regular 1:1s, call reviews and deal reviews Own team targets, pipeline and forecasting across the DACH market Help the team win larger and more complex customers as we continue to move upmarket Get involved in key deals and support the team with customer meetings, objections, negotiations and closing Help Account Executives improve their discovery, pitching and ability to work with multiple stakeholders Make sure we have a healthy pipeline and a clear view of where revenue is coming from Look at where deals are progressing, where they are getting stuck and what we can do differently Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success and the wider commercial team to improve how we find and win customers across our global target market Improve our sales processes and playbooks as the team grows Hire and onboard new Account Executives as we continue to build the DACH team The experience you bring Experience leading a B2B SaaS sales team, ideally with Account Executives selling into the DACH market A strong sales background and a track record of delivering against team revenue targets Experience working across different deal sizes, including larger opportunities with longer sales cycles and multiple decision makers Experience helping a team move upmarket and win larger customers You enjoy coaching and know how to help salespeople improve rather than simply telling them what to do You’re comfortable getting involved in deals and working alongside your team when needed You understand what good pipeline management and forecasting looks like You’re confident using CRM data to understand performance and where the team needs support You’re comfortable joining a growing company where processes are still being built and improved You’re able to balance hitting the numb

jobs.title: Static Ad Designer
jobs.description: About Uplane Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building the AI technology for the marketing agency of the future. Our software supports creative producers with static ad creation, video ad creation, landing page design, and much more. We are building the AI software for the next generation of AI-native content producers and need ambitious, creative ad designers with strong taste who will use our AI engine to deliver high-performing static ads for our customers. About The Role We're seeking a highly motivated, English-speaking AI-native Static Ad Designer with experience in designing static ads for performance marketing campaigns to join our team full-time (in San Francisco or Berlin on-site, hybrid or remote). In this role, you will work with our self-developed AI static ad engine to create and deliver static ads for the paid social campaigns of our clients. Your creatives will reach millions of people across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok. Why Join Uplane is the best place to learn how to design ads with AI. This is the skill every creative lead will need. Learn how to do it today, not in three years. AI does the grunt work, you do the creative work. Our engine handles the tedious stuff so your time goes into concept, taste and design. Millions of people will see your ads. Take ownership and grow quickly. Join a fast-growing, VC-backed company. Culture: fast-moving, ambitious, fun, humble. Responsibilities AI Static Ad Design: You use our powerful, self-developed AI static ad engine to create and design beautiful static ads that will be seen by millions of people. You are in charge, the AI helps you fulfill your mission. Creative Testing: You develop new angles, hooks and visual concepts, test them in live campaigns and double down on what performs. Team Collaboration: Work with an ambitious team of marketing managers and creative designers to ensure projects are executed to a high standard and in a timely manner. Shape the AI engine: Give feedback to our product and engineering team and shape how our static ad engine will evolve and improve over time. jobs.description: 1958, Fondasol réalise avec succès sa première mission géotechnique. Géotechnique, hydrogéologie, géothermie, sites et sols pollués, géophysique, études de structures…: ses collaborateurs mutualisent leurs compétences pour aider les acteurs de la construction à bâtir durablement leurs projets. Vous mobilisez un réseau d'experts internes pour concevoir des solutions d'ingénierie intégrées et à haute valeur ajoutée 2-Expertise technique et optimisation des projets vous conduisez des études G1 à G5 sur tous types de projets : bâtiments, infrastructures, ouvrages souterrains, ouvrages d'art, ect. Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Services Financiers , tu te positionnes comme un expert des services financiers et du compte professionnel. Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié de nos clients qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur activité et leurs flux financiers au quotidien. Tu les accompagnes notamment sur les sujets liés : à l’ouverture et à la gestion de leur compte professionnel ; au dépôt de capital ; à l’encaissement de leurs clients ; aux moyens de paiement et aux flux financiers associés ; au suivi et à la résolution de leurs demandes liées aux services financiers. Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients dans ces deux langues, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne. Tu interagis également au quotidien avec nos partenaires bancaires sur les sujets liés aux comptes professionnels, au dépôt de capital, à l’encaissement et, plus largement, aux flux financiers de nos clients. Tu joues ainsi un rôle de coordination entre les clients, les équipes internes et nos partenaires bancaires, afin de faciliter le traitement des demandes et d’assurer leur suivi jusqu’à leur résolution. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l’équipe Support Services Financiers , tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients dirigeants, leurs équipes, nos partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes de Pennylane. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherches à comprendre leurs demandes et les situations qu’ils rencontrent concernant leur compte professionnel et les services financiers. Après investigation, ton objectif est d’apporter une réponse claire ou une solution adaptée à ton interlocuteur. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. Tu es l’interlocuteur privilégié de nos clients qui utilisent Pennylane pour gérer leur activité et leurs flux financiers au quotidien. Tu les accompagnes notamment sur les sujets liés : à l’ouverture et à la gestion de leur compte professionnel ; au dépôt de capital ; à l’encaissement de leurs clients ; aux moyens de paiement et aux flux financiers associés ; au suivi et à la résolution de leurs demandes liées aux services financiers. Grâce à ta maîtrise de l’allemand et du français, tu accompagnes les clients dans ces deux langues, notamment ceux situés en Allemagne. En tant que membre de l’équipe Support Services Financiers , tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients dirigeants, leurs équipes, nos partenaires bancaires et les équipes internes de Pennylane. jobs.description: Rattaché(e) au responsable d'équipe et intégré(e) à l'équipe xEV Powertrain Europe, vous contribuez à nos activités d’analyse de la concurrence des véhicules électrifiés (BEV, PHEV, HEV, REEV). Accompagner le déploiement des améliorations produit en production, en coordination avec le Process Leader et les responsables de production locaux. Mettre à jour les données historiques et contribuer au développement des connaissances sur des systèmes et composants complexes. Gérer les activités externes : gestion des fournisseurs, logistique, traitement des données et restitution des résultats. Réaliser des contrôles qualité sur les principaux livrables. Créer et développer des outils de production afin d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle. Requirements Ingénieur généraliste ou ingénieur automobile. Bonne connaissance des systèmes automobiles. Solides bases en physique, génie électrique et thermodynamique. Intérêt marqué pour les véhicules électriques et les technologies de propulsion électrifiée (xEV). jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it. While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 20k to € 200k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place. Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis). You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting : The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role you will: Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline. Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.  Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer. Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs)

jobs.title: FPGA Engineer Intern
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As an FPGA Engineer Intern on Harmattan AI’s compute module team, you will take camera aggregation from concept to real hardware for the first time. Our drones carry more cameras than a single processor can take in, and your job is to show how an FPGA can close that gap. You will own the work end to end, from first design to a demonstrator on the bench. Your results will set how cameras are connected in our next hardware generation. Responsibilities Integrate existing IP cores, write HDL wrappers, simulate and validate FPGA logic that merges multiple camera streams into one. Investigate the system’s limits in camera count, resolution and frame rate. Build the processor-side pipeline that splits the merged stream so each camera stays independently usable. Debug the full chain, from cables and connectors to FPGA logic and camera software on the processor. Deliver a complete demonstrator and documentation that guide our next hardware design. Candidate Requirements Final-year Master’s or engineering school student in electrical engineering, electronics or embedded systems. Previous hands-on experience with FPGAs and digital board design and debugging. Experience writing software that runs close to the hardware; embedded Linux is a plus. Ideally, previous exposure to video or camera interfaces. Hands-on in the lab and comfortable reworking wiring, connectors and test setups to get a system running. Curious, autonomous and persistent when hardware refuses to behave. Full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, with the drive to go the extra mile. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the role As the composite technician on the Airframe team, your core mission is to prototype carbon structures fast, in-house — from mould to finished, quality-checked part — and to bring innovative solutions that make assembly and prototyping easier . A true hands-on professional, you combine technical skills, initiative, and a maker mindset. You build tooling, lay up and finish composite parts (carbon / glass fibre), and turn the engineers' CAD into flight-worthy structures on short cycles. You are also the owner of technical drawings and supplier quotations for the parts you handle, and the one who trains production operators when a design moves to series. You thrive with minimal supervision, favour pragmatic, quick-result approaches over perfect-but-slow tooling, and are equally comfortable laying up a part, machining or printing a mould, and reading a technical drawing. Technical skills Key responsibilities Rapid in-house prototyping (core) Produce carbon prototype structures quickly in-house, choosing the fastest viable route rather than heavy tooling when a proto is the goal. Propose innovative, simple solutions to speed up assembly and prototyping. Design certain parts and prototyping tools yourself (fixtures, adapters, simple structural parts) when it is faster than going through the design loop. Iterate fast with the design engineers: short loops between concept, part and feedback, flagging manufacturability issues before they cost a mould. Tooling & moulds Build and maintain moulds and tooling, in coordination with the design team; machine or 3D-print mould masters, prepare and polish mould surfaces. Design and build layup jigs, trimming templates, bonding and assembly fixtures. Manage the composite workshop consumables and material inventory (fabrics, resins, cores, vacuum consumables) including storage and shelf-life follow-up. Design & documentation Read and interpret 2D/3D drawings and ply books; model simple parts and tooling in CAD when needed; give manufacturability feedback early. Own the technical drawings: produce and keep up to date the manufacturing drawings for the parts and tooling you handle. Write and maintain clear, accessible fabrication procedures, ply books and cure logs on Confluence so processes are repeatable by others. Optimise part designs for their manufacturing process: adapt geometries for plastic injection (wall thickness, draft angles, ribs) or for composite / 3D-printed fabrication (layup feasibility, demoulding, printability), in collaboration with the design engineers. Support & improvement Support assembly and mechanical testing, including preparing test coupons and samples for structural analysis. Identify and propose process and quality improvements; help run the composite workshop safely (dust extraction, PPE, resin handling and waste management). Own the knowledge transfer to production: train the production operators on fabrication and assembly processes, and validate that a process is repeatable by others before handover. Candidate profile Technical diploma or degree in composite materials, mechanical / aerospace manufacturing, industrial technology, or equivalent hands-on experience. Proven experience in rapid in-house composite prototyping (carbon / glass fibre): hand layup, vacuum bagging, infusion and/or prepreg; mould making and surface preparation a strong plus. Track record of quick, pragmatic

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description: About Taurus Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you. Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth. Tasks The Role We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth. This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Main Responsibilities Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments. Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations. Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company. Requirements Your Profile Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment. Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.). Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail. Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner. Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus. Willingness to travel to client locations as required Benefits What We Offer An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions. A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain. A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit. A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer. Note We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

jobs.description: <h2>Who is Artefact?</h2> <p>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. jobs.description: <p>The Security Team of Scopely Explore (formerly known as Niantic) seeks a Senior Security Engineer to improve the security posture of our software development lifecycle, applications, and build infrastructure.</p> <p>Scopely Explore, known for global hits like Pokémon GO, Monster Hunter Now, and Pikmin Bloom is now part of Scopely, home to games like Monopoly GO!, Stumble Guys, and Star Trek Fleet Command. Together, we engage billions of players worldwide, and we need your expertise to keep them safe!</p> <p>Do you want to help secure one of the most widely used gaming platforms on the planet? We seek creative and dedicated engineers with excellent technical judgment, strong interpersonal skills, and an eagerness to embrace new technologies.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Implement and maintain agentic or AI-enabled workflows to speed-up common security tasks.</li> <li>Perform security reviews and audits of platform and application software throughout design and launch.</li> <li>Provide guidance and expertise to product and operations teams across Scopely.</li> <li>Design, build and maintain automation and tooling that amplify the Security Team’s impact and improve the developer experience.</li> <li>Drive initiatives in security architecture, application scanning, fuzzing, and other proactive defenses.</li> <li>Contribute to hardening efforts across in-house libraries, CI/CD systems, and cloud/container environments.</li> <li>Be responsible for third-party library reviews and manage vulnerability remediation.</li> <li>Educate engineers on secure coding practices and help standardize security across teams.</li> <li>Engage in red-team exercises and coordinate with internal teams and external pentesting partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelors in Computer Science or related field</li> <li>5+ years of experience in a global company with cloud-centric infrastructure (preferably GCP).</li> <li>You have implemented services and applications with the help of AI tools like Claude, Codex, OpenCode or Gemini and are adept in the use of these tools and adjacent technologies (RAG, MCP, etc).&nbsp;</li> <li>You are capable of creating automation, agentic workflows and tooling to reliably solve problems that scale to the whole enterprise.&nbsp;</li> <li>You have in-depth jobs.description: About Vitestro Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.   At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. jobs.title: Product Owner

Als Product Owner bij Reclamefolder.nl ben je de operationele rechterhand van de Product Manager en zorg je ervoor dat het productteam altijd weet wat er gebouwd moet worden, waarom dat belangrijk is en hoe succes wordt gemeten. Je vertaalt inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek naar concrete en uitvoerbare features. Daarmee lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de doorontwikkeling van een platform dat 872000 unieke bezoekers per maand ontvangt. Zonder jouw regie ontstaat onduidelijkheid over prioriteiten, scope en requirements, waardoor de ontwikkeling van het platform vertraagt. Dit doe je onder andere door: Productkeuzes en inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek te vertalen naar goed uitgewerkte features met heldere user stories, acceptatiecriteria, edge cases en meetpunten. Refinements voor te bereiden, de backlog actueel en overzichtelijk te houden en ervoor te zorgen dat web-, iOS-, Android- en backendteams altijd vooruit kunnen werken. Het eerste aanspreekpunt te zijn voor developers, UX en de Tech Lead bij functionele vragen en binnen de gestelde kaders zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen over scope en uitwerking. De scope tijdens development te bewaken, functionele validaties voor te bereiden met testscenario's en acceptatiechecks en opgeleverde features te controleren op iOS, Android en web. Verzoeken van DPG Media, sales en andere interne stakeholders te analyseren, samen te werken met de UX'er en data-analist aan de juiste KPI's en meetpunten en advies te geven over prioritering. Wie zijn wij? Wij zijn Reclamefolder.nl. Wij geloven dat het mogelijk is om mensen te helpen besparen op hun dagelijkse uitgaven. We bevinden ons midden in een transformatie waarin de digitale folder volledig wordt vernieuwd en het platform opnieuw wordt opgebouwd. Reclamefolder.nl heeft een ondernemende cultuur met ongeveer 25 collega's binnen IT, marketing en sales. Hoewel we onderdeel zijn van DPG Media, opereren we zelfstandig. Hierdoor heb je veel invloed op de productontwikkeling en bedrijfsvoering, terwijl je tegelijkertijd profiteert van de kennis en expertise van een grote mediaorganisatie. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair productteam bestaande uit een Product Manager, webdeveloper, iOS-developer, Android-developer, backenddevelopers, een UX'er, een data-analist en een Tech Lead. In deze rol geef je de Product Manager ruimte om zich te richten op discovery, strategie en klantcontact, terwijl jij zorgt voor een backlog met features die klaar zijn om ontwikkeld te worden. Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat? 2 jaar ervaring als Product Owner Hbo-werk- en denkniveau, een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal en ervaring met het werken in multidisciplinaire productteams. Ervaring met het zelfstandig uitwerken van backlog-items voor een digitaal product en samenwerking met developers, bijvoorbeeld als Product Owner, Business Analyst of in een vergelijkbare rol. Ervaring met het schrijven van duidelijke user stories en acceptatiecriteria die zonder aanvullende toelichting door ontwikkelaars kunnen worden opgepakt. Het vermogen om stakeholderverzoeken te vertalen naar een helder probleem met een duidelijke scope en prioriteit, waarbij je waar nodig duidelijke keuzes maakt. Basiskennis van tracking en analytics, zoals events, funnels en dashboards. Ervaring met het opstellen van een meetplan voor nieuwe features. jobs.description: Amsterdam or Antwerp – As a Backend Engineer within the GenAI Platform team, you help build the foundation that enables AI products across DPG Media. You design and develop scalable backend solutions that support identity, access management and platform insights for a growing portfolio of AI services. Ready to make an impact on the future of AI at DPG Media? Read on! What will you do? As a Backend Engineer, you take ownership of the platform capabilities that enable teams across DPG Media to securely use and manage AI products. You build backend services that unify user, access, usage and cost data while making architectural decisions that support the platform's continued growth. Your work ensures that new products and teams can be onboarded efficiently and consistently. You do this by: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Defining how users, roles and permissions are managed centrally and applied consistently across every product on the GenAI Platform. Building backend services that collect, combine and expose usage, cost and user data for the platform portal and reporting. Designing scalable platform architecture that continues to perform as the number of products grows. Defining how platform resources are described so new products and teams can be added through configuration instead of custom development. Who are we? We are a small team that builds and operates the GenAI Platform used across DPG Media. The platform runs on Kubernetes and provides teams throughout the organisation with access to AI products, ranging from workflow automation to model hosting. What makes you the ideal candidate? For this role, we are looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical expertise with ownership and a pragmatic mindset. You are proactive, analytical and enjoy building scalable platform solutions. In addition, you bring: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Around 5 years of backend engineering experience, including designing systems yourself. Proficiency in at least one backend language. We work with Go, TypeScript and Python, and you are willing to work across these technologies. Experience integrating third-party APIs and combining data from multiple sources into one consistent view. Hands-on experience with OAuth2/OIDC, role-based access models and running services on Kubernetes. Experience adding metrics and alerts to the services you build. Additional experience with Go, Kubernetes controllers or operators, declarative reconcile-based systems, usage metering, FinOps data, Terraform or GenAI systems is considered an advantage. How do you work? You take ownership of your work from design through delivery and beyond. You focus on delivering practical solutions first and continuously improve them. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, clearly explain your reasoning and remain open to alternative perspectives. You think ahead when making design decisions and build with long-term scalability in mind. Our stack li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Languages: Go for the platform control plane, TypeScript and Python for services and APIs. Platform: Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS, Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD. Observability: Grafana, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry. CI/CD: GitHub Actions. At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we invite you to apply for this position. It is precisely through the differences between colleagues that surprising insights and innovative solutions emerge. And that fits very well with us as an organisation. We are curious about who you are and what qualities and experience you bring. Want to know more about our inclusive working environment, click here! What do we offer? At DPG Media, you will work in an inspiring environment that is constantly evolving.

Met jouw technische inzicht en commerciële affiniteit ontwikkel en optimaliseer je audiences en dataproposities, zodat adverteerders hun doelgroepen effectief kunnen bereiken. Je neemt eigenaarschap over onze data offering, je volgt de prestaties, signaleert verbeterkansen en werkt continu aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons aanbod. Je wordt onderdeel van het Advertising Data (BENE)-team binnen de afdeling Digital Sales Development. Ons team bestaat uit 17 collega's uit Nederland en België en richt zich op het ontwikkelen van nieuwe dataproposities, het aansluiten van nieuwe partners, het bouwen van eigen tools, het ontwikkelen van slimme AI-oplossingen en het aantonen van de kracht van onze data. jobs.title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) - Vollzeit
jobs.description: Wirtschaftsinformatiker / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) für agentische Softwareentwicklung Die Kanzlei Prinz ist auf Online-Reputationsrecht spezialisiert: Für über 2.300 Mandanten, überwiegend mittelständische Unternehmen, sorgen wir dafür, dass rechtswidrige Bewertungen auf Plattformen wie kununu, Google und Trustpilot verschwinden. Dabei läuft bei uns alles über unser selbst entwickeltes Case-Management-System. Software als Grundlage unserer Dienstleistung So wie Software zum Service geworden ist (SaaS), entwickelt sich heute auch das Dienstleistungsgeschäft hin zu Software. Unsere Dienstleistung eignet sich dafür besonders gut: Wir bearbeiten sehr viele gleichartige Fälle nach klar definierten Abläufen, und Software sorgt dafür, dass dabei nichts liegen bleibt und nichts übersehen wird. Bei uns ist das nicht neu: Wir haben schon softwaregetrieben gearbeitet, bevor KI zum Thema wurde – und genau das ermöglicht unser solides Wachstum. Unser Ansatz: Wir entwickeln mit KI-Agenten – was dabei entsteht, ist aber deterministische, nachvollziehbare Software. In unseren Arbeitsabläufen setzen wir KI nur ein, wenn es nötig ist; die rechtliche Einschätzung bleibt in juristischer Hand. Wer jetzt dazukommt, lernt das System von Grund auf kennen und baut es Schritt für Schritt mit aus. Warum wir dich suchen Unser Kanzleiinhaber Matthias Prinz hat selbst Wirtschaftsinformatik (B. Sc.) an der TU München studiert. Wir wissen also ziemlich genau, was zu tun ist – Ideen, Konzepte und ein gut gefülltes Backlog haben wir. Derzeit setzen wir drei bis fünf Verbesserungen pro Tag um. Mit einer Entwicklerin oder einem Entwickler in Vollzeit wollen wir die Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit erhöhen – durchdacht, getestet und passend zur bestehenden Architektur. Die fachliche Richtung ist klar – die technisch saubere Umsetzung liegt bei dir. Kein Beratungsgeschäft, keine wechselnden Kundenprojekte: Du entwickelst für dein eigenes Team und siehst jeden Tag, wie deine Software die Arbeit erleichtert. Deine Aufgaben Agentische Softwareentwicklung (dein Schwerpunkt): Du entwickelst unser Case-Management-System weiter (Python/FastAPI, React/TypeScript, Microsoft SQL Server, Azure) – mit KI-Agenten wie Claude Code: Du schreibst Spezifikationen, lässt die Agenten umsetzen, prüfst jedes Ergebnis kritisch und bringst es sicher in den Live-Betrieb. Deterministisch statt KI im Ablauf: Was sich mit klassischer Software lösen lässt, setzt du ohne KI um – mit festen Regeln und prüfbarer Logik. Schnittstellen & Automatisierung: Du bindest Systeme per API und Webhook an, etwa Microsoft 365, lexoffice und das besondere elektronische Anwaltspostfach (beA), und überführst bestehende Power-Automate-Flows in Azure Functions. Anforderungen aufnehmen: Du hörst unseren Kolleginnen und Kollegen genau zu, verstehst ihre Abläufe und übersetzt ihre Anliegen in klare Lösungen. Die Prioritäten stimmst du mit Matthias Prinz ab. Betrieb & Qualität: Du sicherst deine Arbeit mit automatisierten Tests ab, behältst Logs und Schnittstellen im Blick und findest bei Störungen systematisch die Ursache. Pflege und Fehlerbehebung gehören genauso dazu wie neue Funktionen. Schulung: Du stellst neue Funktionen im Team vor und schulst deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Umgang damit. Wir bieten: Klare Rolle: Eine Fachposition ohne Personalverantwortung – du arbeitest direkt mit dem Kanzleiinhaber zusammen, der deine Sprache spricht. Kurze Wege, klare Absprachen. Gepflegte Codebasis: Automatisierte Tests, Typprüfung und dokumentierte Architektur – kein Altsystem aus den 90ern. Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Die Kanzleiprozesse lernst du über unsere Schulungsplattform mit Checklisten und Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen kennen. Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Unbefristete Anstellung von Anfang an. Harmonisches Miteinander: Ein eingespieltes, derzeit überwiegend weibliches Team, in dem man sich aufeinander verlassen kann – in hellen, modernen Büros am Mainzer Rheinufer. Gleitzeit und gutes Gehalt Abgeschlossene

jobs.title: Marketing Manager Digital & Lead Generation (m/w/d) / B2B / Energiewirtschaft / 50-60
jobs.description: Du baust lieber Kampagnen, die Kunden bringen, als Präsentationen darüber, wie man Kunden gewinnen könnte? Dann haben wir einen Job, der dir gefallen dürfte. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors. In this role, you'll combine AI skills, technical expertise, and passion for great didactic experiences to usher in the next generation of education .  About the role This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with subject matter experts and leverage in-house-built cutting-edge AI tooling to scale high-quality course creation across AI engineering: building applications with large language models (LLMs), prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and related topics such as evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, and LLMOps. Here's what your day-to-day will look like: Manage the entire content development lifecycle and deadlines. Source and recruit top-tier subject-matter experts as instructors. Collaborate with instructors to create engaging content. Consistently leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and more to drive high-quality content production at scale. Design, review, and create content on LLM application development, prompt and context engineering, RAG and vector databases, agents and tool use, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of AI systems, and related topics. You will review content from a learner perspective, ensuring it is technically accurate, reflects current AI engineering best practices in a fast-moving field, and is pedagogically effective. Continuously assess course performance using learner feedback and engagement data to drive improvements. Identify and prioritize existing curriculum gaps or new topics in DataCamp's AI engineering curriculum. We're excited about you because you have the following: A solid hands-on background building and shipping production AI applications as an AI engineer, machine learning engineer, or software engineer. Experience taking LLM-powered systems from prototype to production (e.g. evaluation, monitoring, cost and latency optimization) is a strong plus. Broad AI engineering fluency spanning LLM fundamentals, prompt and context engineering, RAG, agents, and evaluation, with additional depth in at least one area such as agentic systems, retrieval and search, fine-tuning, or LLMOps. A solid technical background in Python, with comfort working with LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), open-source models and frameworks (e.g. Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex), agentic systems, vector databases, Git, and the command line. Intuitive understanding of instructional design, with proven ability to structure and teach technical concepts clearly. Graduate degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related STEM field—or equivalent industry experience. Strong experience with agentic coding systems, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Replit. You consider yourself a sophisticated user of these tools. Bonus if you have the following: A deep understanding of the DataCamp course format—you have an intuitive understanding of what makes a great DataCamp course. An existing network of potential subject matter experts who can become DataCamp instructors. An extensive track record of teaching AI engineering to technical audiences. We agree the goal, and you find the way.</li> <li><strong>Travel opportunity.</strong> You will be joining our 10+ conferences.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do</strong></h2> <p>Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. EDISYS , filiale du groupe INTESCIA , est une entreprise innovante spécialisée dans la data et la Business Intelligence. Nous offrons des solutions performantes et sur-mesure pour booster la réussite commerciale de nos clients, notamment dans le domaine des marchés publics. Forts de notre expertise en science des données et en intelligence artificielle, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la transformation numérique et la prise de décision stratégique. Une culture d’innovation, où la créativité et l’amélioration continue sont au cœur de notre ADN. Des équipes passionnées et engagées, évoluant dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif. Votre mission : Développer, fidéliser et faire grandir un portefeuille de clients existants en créant une relation de confiance durable. Vous accompagnez vos clients (principalement des clients du BTP et de la construction) dans leurs enjeux business et identifiez les opportunités de développement de nos solutions. Vos activités : Gérer et développer un portefeuille de clients existants. Identifier les opportunités d'upsell, de cross-sell et de renouvellement. Commercialiser les nouveaux produits et services auprès de votre portefeuille. Accompagner les clients dans l'évolution de leurs besoins et garantir leur satisfaction. Construire une relation de partenariat durable avec les décideurs. Collaborer avec les équipes Customer Success, Tech et Data afin d'assurer un accompagnement de qualité. Piloter les renouvellements contractuels et contribuer à la fidélisation des clients. Participer à la détection d'opportunités pouvant conduire à l'ouverture de nouveaux projets ou de nouvelles filiales. Le profil que nous recherchons : Vous aimez le challenge et développer des relations de confiance sur le long terme et accompagner vos clients dans leur croissance. Vous avez une forte sensibilité business et savez détecter les opportunités de développement. Expérience : Expérience significative (3 à 5 ans) en gestion et développement de comptes BtoB, idéalement dans les secteurs du BTP et de la construction, et/ou à minima dans la technologie la data. Une expérience en fidélisation, upsell et gestion de comptes stratégiques est également fortement appréciée. Un bac+5 dans le domaine commercial sera grandement apprécié. Vos compétences : ▪ Excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens du conseil. ▪ Capacité à développer un portefeuille client et à créer de la valeur. ▪ Maîtrise des techniques de négociation et de vente additionnelle. ▪ Sens de l'écoute et compréhension des enjeux clients. ▪ Esprit collaboratif et orientation satisfaction client. ▪ Organisation, autonomie et force de proposition. La rémunération annuelle fixe sur ce poste sera de 43K à 55K€ en fonction du profil que nous recruterons. Egalement, un variable déplafonné sur objectifs sera présent. La connaissance du marché des acteurs du marché du BTP et de la construction sera un + pour votre réussite. jobs.description: Unité : CERI MP Responsables : Dr. CHARLON Sébastien, Pr. SAMUEL Cédric, Dr. Amulya RAJ Nature de l’emploi : Stage de master 2 ou équivalent d’une durée de 6 mois Lieu de travail : Douai (59)   Description de l’IMT Nord Europe :   École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille. IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital. jobs.title: Computational Biologist
jobs.description: About Proxima Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others. Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time. In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions. Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models, and coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. Come join us! About You: Proxima is seeking highly-motivated Computational Biologists interested in building the leading AI-enabled drug discovery platform for novel induced proximity therapeutic modality. Successful candidates will work closely with the Computational Chemistry, Machine Learning and Application Engineering teams to tap into the wealth of evolutionary, structural and -omics data to unlock the full potential of unified machine learning representations and large-scale geometric deep learning generative models. jobs.title: Automation Engineer – Magnet Industrialisation
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. TEAM & ROLE Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT You will support the industrialisation of production processes for magnet production, contributing directly to the execution of key activities within Proxima’s magnet program. You will play a central role in designing, programming and operating automation cells performing a wide array of production processes such as welding, bonding, sealing and coating. You will operate across a wide range of technical tasks, from design and engineering to hands on production work, and collaborating closely with engineers and technicians WHAT YOU WILL DO Advise on future line design and automation concepts Define the requirements for automation cells for different processes to ensure performance, repeatability and safe operation Contribute to the development of control strategies for new production lines You will build and commission automation cells, including running FAT at supplier sites Identify and test different manufacturing and in-process monitoring approaches Design jigs and tools for magnet industrialised production Support in the process development and prototyping of magnets, with scalability and repeatability in mind. Collaborate closely with engineers and technicians across multiple teams WHO YOU ARE A master´s degree in mechanical, mechatronics or similar engineering field A wide experience in robotics, automation and process monitoring in an industrial setting Strong hands-on experience in production environments over a wide range of production processes (for ex. welding, machining, assembly, bonding) Experience with robotic simulation and offline programming (e.g. RoboGuide, RobotStudio, Process Simulate). Previous work on FANUC systems is a plus Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Ethernet, Profinet) Proficient in industrial-level PLC programming Ability to work across a variety of tasks in a dynamic environment Reliable, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset Strong team player,

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: About Unblu Unblu helps the world's leading banks and insurance companies deliver conversational finance solutions. We provide highly secure engagement and collaboration software, enabling financial institutions to enrich the digital experience of their clients. By choosing a career with Unblu you choose to join an international, and innovation-savvy company. With our head office situated in Basel, Switzerland and additional offices in Bulgaria, Germany, the UK, Canada and the USA, you’ll be joining an international team dedicated to shaping the future of digital engagement. While Unblu is run as an independent company with global scope, we are fortunate to have Swiss Post as our anchor shareholder, providing long term support and vision to the company.  The Role We're looking for a Security Engineer to work alongside our SRE and engineering teams, embedding security across the full software development lifecycle. You'll own a mix of defensive operations and developer-facing security tooling, from WAF rule management and CVE triage to building the pipelines that keep our deployments safe by default. This role sits at the intersection of application security, platform security and operations. You'll partner closely with engineering to ship secure software, and with SRE when things need to be hardened or investigated. We run entirely in the cloud, with a strong focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You'll report to our VP SRE. An on-call rotation shared with SRE may be part of this role; we'll finalize expectations with the successful candidate. Responsibilities Embed security practices throughout the software development lifecycle, from design review to production monitoring, working hands-on with engineering teams Build, maintain and evolve the security tooling in our GitLab CI/CD pipelines: SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection and container scanning Review Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) for our applications, track supply chain risk and drive remediation of issues in third-party components Own CVE triage end to end: assess relevance, prioritize based on exposure and exploitability, and coordinate remediation with product teams Manage and tune our Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, balancing strong protection against false-positive noise Run internal security audits, document findings clearly and work with teams to close gaps Coordinate our annual external penetration test end to end; review pen test reports commissioned by our customers, translate findings into actionable work and respond back to the customer Lead the technical investigation, containment and recovery of security incidents together with SRE Provide technical evidence for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits, DORA resilience testing and customer security questionnaires, together with our Compliance Manager Help run or grow our external bug bounty program (optional scope): triage reports, coordinate with researchers and drive fixes through engineering Requirements Practical, hands-on security experience in a SOC, incident response or security engineering context, where you've done the work, not just written policy A degree, recognized certification (OSCP, CISSP, GIAC or equivalent) or structured training in information security Comfortable working across the entire software lifecycle, shifting between developer collaboration, operations and governance Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally in GitLab CI Familiarity with vulnerability scanners, SBOM tools (Syft, Grype, Trivy, Dependency-Track or similar) and WAF platforms (Cloud Armor, Cloudflare or similar) Working knowledge of GCP security primitives (IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, Secret Manager, Binary Authorization, Security Command Center); comparable experience in another major cloud is fine if you're ready to go deep on GCP A clear communicator who can explain risk to engineers in terms they'll act on, and present confidently to customer security teams

jobs.title: AI Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Hoe lang duurt dit ziekteverzuim? Hoeveel stroom levert het windpark morgen? Welke klant staat open voor een volgend product? Organisaties willen het antwoord weten voordat het zover is. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer zorg jij dat die voorspelling er komt: betrouwbaar, herhaalbaar en verankerd in het werk van echte gebruikers. De uitdaging Generatieve AI trekt de aandacht, maar predictive AI levert vaak de harde waarde. De twee lossen verschillende problemen op en versterken elkaar. Jij weet welke aanpak bij welk vraagstuk past, en waar de grenzen liggen.  Als AI Machine Learning Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers ,    zoals overheden, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Daar tref je vaak data waar nog veel meer uit te halen valt. Jij maakt er producten op basis van AI van die werken. Je werk bestaat onder meer uit: Statistische analyses en dataverkenning om haalbaarheid en aanpak snel helder te krijgen. Data pipelines bouwen en de juiste featureset samenstellen voor modeltraining. Modellen ontwikkelen, van gradient boosting tot deep learning. Modelregistratie, experiment tracking en modelvisualisaties op orde houden. Modellen ontsluiten via FastAPI, zodat ze aanroepbaar zijn binnen het bestaande applicatielandschap. Met coding agents vind je sneller de juiste libraries en creeër je inzicht zodat de haalbaarheid en juiste aanpak snel boven water komen. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat AI wel en niet kan. Je werkt pragmatisch en zet door tot de mensen voor wie je modellen bedoeld zijn ze dagelijks gebruiken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij de AI& Data Squad: Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Onze ambitie is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland te worden. Daarvoor bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot voorspelmodellen op Databricks. Jij denkt daar actief over mee. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag met alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een dag voor kennisdelen, leren en verbinden.  Lees  hier  meer over de AI squad. Ervaring met modellen en frameworks zoals LightGBM, XGBoost en Keras. Ervaring met platformen als Azure ML, Databricks, AWS SageMaker of GCP Vertex AI. Ervaring met pandas, polars of Spark, en met exploratie in Jupyter en Seaborn. Ervaring met tracking en orkestratie via MLflow, Prefect of Airflow. Je kunt onderbouwen welk model of welke tool in welke situatie het beste werkt, en je maakt je nieuwe tools snel eigen. Je volgt generatieve AI op de voet, van prompt via context naar harness engineering, en weet hoe je oplossingen met LLM’s evalueert, monitort en verbetert. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Dit is een brede range omdat wij zowel op zoek zijn naar medior als senior Engineers. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling. We design structured test journeys — both manual and automated — across many different environments to detect issues early and help our clients understand what is really happening. From our HQ in Rotterdam, a small and highly technical team of around 20 people works for some of the world’s largest banks. We call ourselves ethical techies : curious technical people who enjoy breaking things in order to make them better. Incidents don’t scare us; they make us curious. What you’ll be doing This role is quite different from the average systems or infrastructure position. You won’t be one small part of a large DevOps transformation. jobs.title: IT Architect - Business Domain
jobs.description: Hoe laat je een CRM, BPM, procesautomatisering, pensioenadministratie en maatwerk goed samenwerken? Hoe kunnen we AI en data concreet inzetten binnen het pensioendomein? Als onze IT Architect voor onze businessdomeinen vertaal je businessvragen naar concrete IT-oplossingen en praktisch advies. Je helpt teams en stakeholders om onderbouwde keuzes te maken over applicaties, platformen en integraties. Daarbij kijk je verder dan één systeem: je zorgt dat oplossingen werken in de praktijk én passen binnen de architectuur voor het pensioendomein.   Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt bij het Architecture team binnen de afdeling Digital Strategy, Architecture & Innovation. Samen met collega-architecten ben je verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur van het totale pensioendomein. Jullie verbinden de behoeften van de pensioenbusiness met de ontwikkeling van het IT-landschap en bewaken gezamenlijk de samenhang en richting binnen het domein. Je werkt nauw samen met business-, change- en platformteams en leveranciers om architectuurkeuzes te vertalen naar uitvoerbare oplossingen. Als IT architect voor het pensioendomein ligt je zwaartepunt bij applicatie-, platform- en integratiearchitectuur. Je overziet de samenhang tussen klantbediening, pensioenprocessen, data en technologie en maakt concreet wat een verandering vraagt van de betrokken systemen. Je werkterrein omvat CRM, BPM, portalen, pensioenadministratie, gegevensuitwisseling, marketing technologie en maatwerkapplicaties. Je bent geen architect voor één platform, maar adviseert over oplossingen over de hele keten vanuit het perspectief van de businessbehoefte binnen de kaders van onze IT platformdiensten.    Je verantwoordelijkheden staan niet op zichzelf, maar maken deel uit van de gezamenlijke uitdagingen van de gehele architectuurafdeling. Vanuit je expertise draag je samen met je collega-architecten bij aan de volgende opgaven voor het totale domein:    - Vertalen van businessbehoeften naar concrete architectuurproducten zoals applicatie- en integratieontwerpen en heldere ontwerpkeuzes.  - Adviseren over de inzet van CRM, Pega BPM, AI platform en andere platformen voor klantinteractie, workflow, casemanagement en procesautomatisering.  - Afwegen wanneer standaardfunctionaliteit, hergebruik, configuratie of maatwerk passend is, met aandacht voor kosten, complexiteit, beheerbaarheid en leveranciersafhankelijkheid door middel van het toepassen van onze architectuurprincipes.  - Ontwerpen van de samenhang tussen applicaties, API’s, gegevensstromen en koppelingen, in samenwerking met data- en technologiearchitecten.  - Uitwerken van doel- en transitiearchitecturen en praktische roadmaps, met oog voor bestaande systemen, technische schuld en lopende veranderingen.  - Samen met collega-architecten bewaken van de samenhang over domeinen heen en vastleggen van belangrijke keuzes in begrijpelijke, bruikbare architectuurproducten.  Wat vragen we van jou? - Wo werk- en denkniveau.  - Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een architectuurrol, met aantoonbare ervaring in het ontwerpen en begeleiden van IT-oplossingen.  - Een stevige IT-basis en ervaring met enterprise-applicaties, CRM, workflow-

Du sorgst dafür, dass operative Abläufe rund um Wareneingang, Warenausgang, Transportabstimmung und Kundenkommunikation zuverlässig funktionieren. Dabei arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Kunden, Lager, Spediteuren/Frachtführern und weiteren Beteiligten der Lieferkette. Deine Aufgaben Du betreust operative Customer-Service-Vorgänge im Tagesgeschäft – unter anderem rund um Wareneingänge, Warenausgänge, Umbuchungen, Transporte und Kundenanfragen. Du kommunizierst mit Kunden, Lager, Spediteuren/Frachtführern und weiteren Beteiligten der Lieferkette per Telefon, E-Mail und Reports. Du planst, steuerst und kontrollierst Transporte und stimmst Liefertermine sowie Lade- und Transportmöglichkeiten ab. Du arbeitest in einem Multi-User-Umfeld mit mehreren Kunden und wechselnden Auftragsbereichen – nicht fest zugeordnet zu nur einem Kunden. Du bearbeitest Abweichungen, Reklamationen, Fehlbestände oder Schäden gemeinsam mit Kunden, Lager und weiteren Schnittstellen. Du unterstützt bei administrativen Aufgaben wie Frachtpapieren, Stammdatenpflege, vorbereitender Abrechnung, zolltechnischer Abwicklung sowie weiteren üblichen Büroarbeiten im Customer Service. Dein Profil Du bringst Berufserfahrung oder fundierte Kenntnisse aus Logistik, Spedition oder einem vergleichbaren operativen Umfeld mit. Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich Spedition und Logistikdienstleistung, ist von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend, wenn deine Erfahrung passt. Du hast eine klare Transportaffinität und idealerweise Erfahrung mit Stückgut und/oder im Teil- und Komplettladungsbereich. Du kommunizierst sicher und serviceorientiert – auch telefonisch – und kannst mehrere Kundenanforderungen strukturiert bearbeiten. Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse und vorhandene Englischkenntnisse; MS-Office-Kenntnisse bringst du ebenfalls mit.
